chunks: Regarding them from their cushioned seats.

key_terms.الْأَرَائِكِ: Cushioned seats or divans, implying luxury and comfort.

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'from their cushioned seats' signify in the context of the hypocrites?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the hypocrites' (al-munafiqun) posture of idle observation from their elevated, cushioned seats, symbolizing their spiritual detachment and arrogance during the events of judgment or communal gatherings. This imagery underscores the contrast between their superficial comfort and the impending reality of divine reckoning, a theme frequently discussed by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni.
